resumeRule: Because the connected GitHub capability has no first-class branch/ref deletion action, deletion must be performed by the repository owner. Immediately before manual deletion, re-check main, open PRs and all 25 exact heads. If main or any candidate head moved, do not delete and recompute. After deletion, re-enumerate the complete namespace, prove exactly the authorised refs disappeared modulo independently observed concurrent ref turnover, then update this record and merge it under a fresh main/open-PR lease.
